item.description:
Thimble 0.2.3 gives Android its own thimble icon and fixes the date picker's colors.
- Android's icon is now the same dimpled thimble as the Mac's, on the same indigo. - On Android, the When sheet and its calendar use Thimble's colors again, in every color theme, instead of a pale purple. - The thimble's dimples are evenly spaced on the Mac icon too.
